::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [March 1871]  
**From:** Otterbourne.  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown.  This fragment printed in [<i>Dulce Domum</i>](other_books/otherbook_122.qmd), 231-2.
:::

My dear [Emily](people/person_1012.qmd),
An odd question, but can you tell me what [Edward](people/person_1013.qmd) first taught himself on the violin?  I want Lance Underwood to do it, and must mention some tune . . .

---

**Note:** Edith Emily Moberly (b.1839), third daughter of George Moberly. The date is implied by its position in *Dulce Domum*.
